menu.americanDescription: Spicy pepperoni and melted mozzarella over sweet tomato sauce, finished with a golden, hand-stretched crust baked until crisp.
menu.margheritaDescription: Fresh basil, creamy mozzarella and tomato sauce on a crisp, hand-stretched crust.
menu.review1: The crust had just the right crunch, with plenty of cheese all the way to the edge. I’d order this again.
menu.review2: Loved the tomato sauce and the lightly toasted crust. A new favourite for pizza night.
menu.review3: Fresh out of the oven and perfect for sharing.
